summary: Configured node1 to lock local accounts after five failed password authentications and automatically unlock after 300 seconds. Functional testing succeeded before and after reboot; temporary test users and credentials were removed.
actions_performed: Enabled authselect feature with-faillock for system-auth and password-auth.
Verified five failures lock the account and a valid password is rejected while locked.
Verified automatic unlock after more than 300 seconds.
Restarted node1 once and confirmed its boot ID changed from 4d340bf4-0579-47f0-98c1-5c17a66d50f1 to 009ccc6a-cdba-41f0-b6c4-72d10f7169bd.
Repeated functional PAM testing after restart and removed all disposable test artifacts.

evidence.summary: Authselect is valid with with-faillock enabled; both PAM stacks include pam_faillock; final values are deny=5 and unlock_time=300.

evidence.requirement: Account locks after five failed login attempts
evidence.summary: A valid baseline authentication succeeded, five failed attempts were recorded, and the valid credential was then rejected.

evidence.requirement: Account automatically unlocks after five minutes
evidence.summary: The valid credential was rejected at 19:47:44 and succeeded at 19:52:48, more than 300 seconds after the fifth failure.

Captured a healthy pre-restart state and old boot ID, acknowledged the scheduled native reboot, observed disconnection, confirmed a new boot ID, then verified system/SSHD health, persistent configuration, and working lockout behavior on the new boot.
